question: What RGB values are listed in Table 2A-2 for fluorescent yellow-green?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2A-2 does not list any RGB values. It is a matrix of "Common Uses of Sign Colors" that indicates (with "X" marks) which colors — including fluorescent yellow-green — are used as legend or background colors for various sign types; it contains no numeric color specifications. Per the MUTCD, color coordinates and values are described in 23 CFR, Part 655, Subpart F, Appendix, not in Table 2A-2, so the evidence provided is insufficient to give RGB values. Standards (mandatory): - (For context on what fluorescent yellow-green means, not RGB values) "Fluorescent Yellow-Green—pedestrian warning, bicycle warning, playground warning, school bus warning, and school warning." Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-2 (p.44 as printed), which uses only "X" entries to indicate common legend/background color combinations — fluorescent yellow-green appears as a background for Pedestrian, Bicycle, and School warning signs and as a legend color for School/Pedestrian/Bicycle changeable message signs, with no RGB or other numeric color values anywhere in the table. Citations: - Table 2A-2 (p.43) - Section 2A.06 Support §3 (p.43) - Section 1D.05 Standard §2 (p.33)
